name: Flare Stack
designIntent: A polar-night raid on the Directorate's refinery fields, riding flare-tower thermal blooms to stay invisible to heat sensors, then destroying the cracking train. Introduces arctic heat-dissipation bonuses and ice-footing penalties.

briefing.speaker: Ekene
briefing.text: The pole is where the Directorate makes this occupation pay, Lodestar. Their refinery fields run through the polar night without pause — cracking units breaking Veyran crude into fleet fuel, guarded by machines that see in heat, because out here everything warm is a target. Everything warm except the flare stacks. Those towers vent burning gas day and night, and every bloom is a wall of white across their thermal picture. That is your road in. Move stack to stack, ride the blooms, and stay dark in between. Your objective is the cracking train itself — the tall units with the external pipework. Put them down and the Directorate's fleet starts drinking its reserves. The cold is on our side for once; your sinks will love it. The ice will not. Watch your footing at speed. Full team, radio discipline until the first charge goes — and then, pilot, it stops being a raid and starts being a statement. Make it. Ekene out.

objectives.title: Ride the Blooms
objectives.description: Infiltrate the refinery field by moving stack to stack inside the flare-tower thermal blooms.

objectives.title: Break the Cracking Train
objectives.description: Destroy all three cracking units along the refinery spine.

objectives.title: Out of the Light
objectives.description: Exfiltrate through the pipe alleys to the glacier rim before the response lance seals the field.

objectives.title: Dry the Reserves
objectives.description: Destroy the fuel bowser park feeding the garrison's mechs.

enemyForces: Thermal-sensor drone screens sweeping between stacks
Refinery security lance: Gabbro and Halite on standing patrol
Recessed turrets along the cracking spine
Guard skiffs running the ice channels
One Basalt response element out of the garrison after the first detonation
setPieces: Aurora over the polar night — the refinery burning like a grounded constellation
Flare stacks breathe and thermal vision whites out — your cover, on a rhythm
The first cracking unit chains up its own pipework in a fireball that turns night to noon
A sliding, skating exfil across black ice with tracers overhead
failConditions: Fewer than three cracking units destroyed
Fireteam wiped inside the refinery field
Player mech destroyed — pilot ejects, mission failed
salvageNotes: Refinery kills freeze clean — arctic wrecks keep their internals, and the security lance pays full claims if dropped away from the burning spine. Bowser-park kills pay in fuel scrip instead of chassis. Anything that dies inside a detonation radius is simply gone.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Ekene
voTriggers.line: Polar rules, Lodestar: the cold is your friend, the ice is not, and everything warm out here is a target — including you. Stay in the blooms.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: External temperature minus forty-one degrees. Heat dissipation improved to one hundred twenty-five percent of rated. Surface traction reduced — sharp turns at speed risk a fall.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Advisory: flare-stack thermal output exceeds your signature by two orders of magnitude. Within approximately one hundred meters of an active bloom, thermal sensors cannot resolve you.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Stacks breathe on a cycle — I'm reading roughly forty seconds bloom, twenty dark. Move on the bloom, freeze in the dark. It's a dance, Lodestar. You lead.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: Drone screen passing— holding... holding... it went right over us. The blooms actually work. Relay, your plan actually works.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Vireo, wounding. My plans always work. Statistically often.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Charge armed on cracking unit one. Expect immediate garrison response upon detonation.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: WHOA-HO! Now THAT is a bonfire! The pole just got its own sunrise, courtesy of the Compact!

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: There's the bill: security lance closing from the pump houses, and a Basalt just left the garrison with your name on it. Two crackers to go — keep moving.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Traction loss detected. Gyros compensating. Wider turning arcs are advised on ice.

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Third cracker down. The spine is burning end to end.

voTriggers.speaker: Ekene
voTriggers.line: Three crackers dead, and the Directorate's fleet drinks its reserves tonight. Rest warm, fireteam. At dawn our engineers start the glacier crossing — and I will be on the ice with you for that one. Ekene out.
